The Neumann Series Expansion solves the Volume Rendering Integral by expressing the incoming radiance at a point as an infinite sum of contributions from light sources that have undergone $0, 1, 2, \dots$ scattering events [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly states that the Neumann series expansion ($L_i = L_e + GKL_e + (GK)^2GL_e + ...$) represents the incoming radiance $L_i$ as a sum of light that has undergone 0, 1, 2, ... scattering events. It further clarifies that even with 0 scatterings, attenuation ($G$) occurs. This aligns perfectly with the claim.
